# Beauty Pro Supplies Canada

> > Professional beauty, spa, and dental cosmetic supplies for aestheticians, including teeth whitening systems, LED therapy masks, jelly masks, and tooth gems.

Beauty Pro Supplies Canada is a wholesale supplier serving licensed beauty professionals, estheticians, and spa practitioners across Canada. The company specializes in professional-grade skincare treatments, teeth whitening products featuring Smile360 systems and carbamide peroxide formulations, Roselisa jelly masks with hyaluronic acid, and dental cosmetic supplies including Swarovski tooth gems.

- Teeth Whitening & Smile Enhancement
